author: DanielKlaus
quote: Does not feel like a GTA anymore before it was Arcade fast fun Game not realistic Comic look taking it self Not to serious. Now the Game feels slow, sluggish and dull like what they did with the WWE Games many Years ago from their SmackDown Series. Animation over Animation who slow the Game down and feel boring. The Game is too slow that takes away the excitement and brings down the Dopamine Level every GTA Game had in the Past. And the Story even feels disconnected from previous Games. It feels they took realism as priority and forgot what the True Essence of the Game was and what made it in the Past. Even than Putting UFOs Big Foot etc. In the Game makes this difficult to be taking serious so they did not really know If they want a Real or Fun Game and thats excactly what this Game is either Hot or Cold something between and this is suppose to be a 10/10 Game from many Reviewers did they even Play the Game? Next Thing IT has No real new Innovations Just copying from other Games like the Sims but not a big Leap from GTA 3 to GTA 5 like it was in the Past why than give it 10/10? Makes No Sense at all... Bigger Map and a little better Graphic and smarter NPCs makes no better Game ITS lost its Spark and its previous Fun IT needs to get Back to the Arcade Roots in GTA 7 If it wants to be a true GTA Game No RDR2 Mix Up Gameplay that is surely a very Bad decision. Seems to me the devs did Not really know what to do with the Game and Just did anything Copy and Paste Mix Up RDR2 Elements and Hope for the best because with that Marketing and the GTA Name nothing can fail. I missed the Love and Heart from the previous Game you could tell IT feels Like they Loved making this Game and it was sooo fun and rewarding Just A great Experience and Time thats now missing and feels completely Off or dull to the older Experience sadly biggest Dissapointment in the Gaming History. Like in Movies the biggest Budget does not make a great Movie.
